note: The terms the exercise pages explain with a popover (src/glossary.ts). Add a term here and name it in an exercise's glossary list.

tick.explain: One step of the shared clock. Every part does its work for the tick and tells the bus it's done; only then does the next tick start.

replyTo.explain: On a reply, the id of the request it answers. It's how a requester matches each reply to its request, like a ticket number.

fault.explain: A reply that says a request failed and why, for example OUT_OF_RANGE for an address memory doesn't have. It replaces the normal reply, so the asker always hears back.

envelope.explain: The fields every NetSim message carries around its contents: type, from, to, id, replyTo and tick. The bus delivers by the envelope and never looks inside.
